rules: Separate agent contexts. Interviewer scripts are never supplied to the user simulator or CoqPi.
User simulator speaks only the exact visible suggestion; no useful suggestion means a failed turn.
Use the actual built application, OS audio devices and providers. Mock regressions are separate evidence.
Use isolated local data, synthetic candidate facts and explicit test audio only.
Never modify user credentials, audio device defaults or installed app during diagnosis.
PASS requires every expected result; blocked hardware and unexecuted scenarios never become PASS.

scenarios.name: English interview
steps: User simulator reads the visible answer verbatim
expected: English answers grounded in selected facts
Correct order and complete saved transcript

scenarios.name: Mixed languages
expected: ME does not switch language or trigger advice

scenarios.name: Headphone loopback call
steps: Select physical microphone and separate loopback

scenarios.name: Source separation
expected: ME retained in archive but excluded from suggestions
No manual control required for dual-source route

scenarios.name: Pending answer invalidation
expected: Old success or error cannot overwrite new session

scenarios.name: Long conversation
steps: Run at least 10 minutes within remaining budget
Use multiple questions and language changes
Refer back to an earlier authorized fact
expected: Latency samples include failures and timeouts

measurements.latencyEnd: First visible usable suggestion; final answer separately
measurements.aggregation: median, nearest-rank p95, worst, sample count, failures and timeouts
measurements.accuracy: Word error rate against held-out reference, plus separate human semantic assessment
